AC12.2-prime.reason: Finding F1 - the doc's V6 base premise (rc=1 with exactly one failing test, TestHandlerTimeoutKillsTheWholeProcessGroup) is REFUTED by the planner's first-party re-derivation on this rig this session: rc=0 with an EMPTY failing-test set and host/verifygate 'ok' in both legs.
